recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **Evaporated milk**: 680 g ([**1:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=77s))
- **Brown sugar**: 400 g *(Used for a richer, deeper flavor than white sugar)* ([**1:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=68s))
- **Large egg yolks**: 6 yolks
- **Cornstarch**: 30 g ([**0:15**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=15s)) *(Note: The video description mistakenly lists all-purpose flour, but Aaron explicitly measures and uses cornstarch to thicken the scratch-made base)* ([**0:15**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=15s))
- **Butter**: 57 g
- **Vanilla paste**: 5 mL
recipe-section-1.html:
• Evaporated milk: 680 g (1:17)
  • Brown sugar: 400 g (Used for a richer, deeper flavor than white sugar) (1:08)
  • Large egg yolks: 6 yolks
  • Cornstarch: 30 g (0:15) (Note: The video description mistakenly lists all-purpose flour, but Aaron explicitly measures and uses cornstarch to thicken the scratch-made base) (0:15)
  • Butter: 57 g
  • Vanilla paste: 5 mL
recipe-section-1.title: The Homemade Pudding Custard

recipe-section-2.html:
• Heavy whipping cream: 237–473 mL
  • Vanilla paste: 5 mL
recipe-section-2.title: The Light Whipped Cream Fold-In

recipe-section-3.markdown:
- **Granulated sugar**: 300 g
- **Butter**: 187 g (Ideally a rich European-style butter like Kerrygold to reduce popping) ([**9:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=566s))
- **Heavy cream**: 250 mL ([**1:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=91s))
- **Sea salt**: 5 mL
recipe-section-3.html:
• Granulated sugar: 300 g
  • Butter: 187 g (Ideally a rich European-style butter like Kerrygold to reduce popping) (9:26)
  • Heavy cream: 250 mL (1:31)
  • Sea salt: 5 mL
recipe-section-3.title: The Salted Caramel Sauce

recipe-section-4.markdown:
- **Bananas**: 6 small bananas ([**18:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1092s))
- **Lotus Biscoff cookies**: 1 package ([**17:56**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1076s)) *(An excellent alternative if you live somewhere like Austria where standard Nilla wafers aren't available)* ([**17:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1068s))
recipe-section-4.html:
• Bananas: 6 small bananas (18:12)
  • Lotus Biscoff cookies: 1 package (17:56) (An excellent alternative if you live somewhere like Austria where standard Nilla wafers aren't available) (17:48)
recipe-section-4.title: The Layering Inclusions

recipe-section-6.markdown: - Place a metal mixing bowl straight into the fridge or freezer ([**3:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=229s)). Whipping cream succeeds best when both the equipment and cream are icy cold ([**3:57**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=237s)).
recipe-section-6.html: • Place a metal mixing bowl straight into the fridge or freezer (3:49). Whipping cream succeeds best when both the equipment and cream are icy cold (3:57).
recipe-section-6.title: Step 1: Prep a Cold Mixing Bowl
recipe-section-6.heading_html: Step 1: Prep a Cold Mixing Bowl

recipe-section-7.markdown: - Set a heavy pot over medium heat ([**0:45**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=45s)). Pour in 400 g of brown sugar, 500 mL of evaporated milk, and 237 mL of heavy cream ([**0:54**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=54s)). Whisk together and bring the mixture to a boil ([**5:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=320s)).
recipe-section-7.html: • Set a heavy pot over medium heat (0:45). Pour in 400 g of brown sugar, 500 mL of evaporated milk, and 237 mL of heavy cream (0:54). Whisk together and bring the mixture to a boil (5:20).
recipe-section-7.title: Step 2: Start the Pudding Liquid

recipe-section-8.markdown: - In a separate bowl, whisk your 6 egg yolks with 30 g of cornstarch until smooth ([**0:38**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=38s)). Once your milk mixture boils, turn off the heat ([**5:42**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=342s)). Slowly drizzle a few splashes of the hot liquid into the eggs while whisking vigorously ([**6:33**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=393s)). This tempers the eggs so you do not accidentally scramble them ([**6:45**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=405s)).
recipe-section-8.html: • In a separate bowl, whisk your 6 egg yolks with 30 g of cornstarch until smooth (0:38). Once your milk mixture boils, turn off the heat (5:42). Slowly drizzle a few splashes of the hot liquid into the eggs while whisking vigorously (6:33). This tempers the eggs so you do not accidentally scramble them (6:45).
recipe-section-8.title: Step 3: Mix the Egg Base and Temper
recipe-section-8.heading_html: Step 3: Mix the Egg Base and Temper

recipe-section-9.markdown: - Pour the tempered egg mixture back into the main pot ([**7:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=450s)). Stir as the residual heat cooks down and visibly thickens the pudding ([**7:42**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=462s)). Remove from the stove and melt in 57 g of butter ([**8:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=508s)). Stir in 5 mL of vanilla paste ([**12:24**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=744s)). Press the pudding through a fine mesh strainer into a bowl to ensure an ultra-smooth finish ([**12:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=731s)), then set it aside to chill ([**11:59**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=719s)).
recipe-section-9.html: • Pour the tempered egg mixture back into the main pot (7:30). Stir as the residual heat cooks down and visibly thickens the pudding (7:42). Remove from the stove and melt in 57 g of butter (8:28). Stir in 5 mL of vanilla paste (12:24). Press the pudding through a fine mesh strainer into a bowl to ensure an ultra-smooth finish (12:11), then set it aside to chill (11:59).
recipe-section-9.title: Step 4: Thicken and Strain the Custard
recipe-section-9.heading_html: Step 4: Thicken and Strain the Custard

recipe-section-10.markdown: - In a separate pot over medium heat, add 300 g of regular granulated sugar ([**2:09**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=129s)). Let it sit undisturbed until the sugar melts down into a golden amber liquid ([**4:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=251s)). Scrape the sides occasionally so it does not burn ([**6:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=386s)).
recipe-section-10.html: • In a separate pot over medium heat, add 300 g of regular granulated sugar (2:09). Let it sit undisturbed until the sugar melts down into a golden amber liquid (4:11). Scrape the sides occasionally so it does not burn (6:26).
recipe-section-10.title: Step 5: Melt the Caramel Sugar

recipe-section-11.markdown: - Turn off the heat and drop 187 g of butter into the amber sugar ([**8:51**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=531s)). Once the butter melts, pour in 237 mL of heavy cream and 5 mL of sea salt ([**10:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=631s)). It will bubble up fiercely but keep stirring until it forms a unified sauce ([**9:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=566s)). Run the caramel through a clean strainer, transfer it to a jar, and let it cool ([**10:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=649s)).
recipe-section-11.html: • Turn off the heat and drop 187 g of butter into the amber sugar (8:51). Once the butter melts, pour in 237 mL of heavy cream and 5 mL of sea salt (10:31). It will bubble up fiercely but keep stirring until it forms a unified sauce (9:26). Run the caramel through a clean strainer, transfer it to a jar, and let it cool (10:49).
recipe-section-11.title: Step 6: Finish the Salted Caramel Sauce
recipe-section-11.heading_html: Step 6: Finish the Salted Caramel Sauce

recipe-section-12.markdown: Retrieve your frozen metal bowl ([**14:36**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=876s)). Add your heavy cream and 5 mL of vanilla paste ([**14:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=886s)), then whip until soft-to-medium peaks form ([**14:57**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=897s)). Pull your chilled pudding base out of the freezer and gently fold the whipped cream into it a little at a time ([**15:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=940s)). This incorporates air, making the pudding beautifully light and fluffy ([**14:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=870s)).
recipe-section-12.html: Retrieve your frozen metal bowl (14:36). Add your heavy cream and 5 mL of vanilla paste (14:46), then whip until soft-to-medium peaks form (14:57). Pull your chilled pudding base out of the freezer and gently fold the whipped cream into it a little at a time (15:40). This incorporates air, making the pudding beautifully light and fluffy (14:30).
recipe-section-12.title: Step 7: Whip the Cream and Fold
recipe-section-12.heading_html: Step 7: Whip the Cream and Fold

recipe-section-13.markdown: Peel your bananas and slice them ([**16:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1012s)). Cutting them on a slight diagonal yields great, chunky bites for the final assembly ([**18:21**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1101s)).
recipe-section-13.html: Peel your bananas and slice them (16:52). Cutting them on a slight diagonal yields great, chunky bites for the final assembly (18:21).
recipe-section-13.title: Step 8: Chop the Bananas

recipe-section-14.markdown: - Grab a glass serving dish ([**20:15**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1215s)). Lay down a foundation layer of Biscoff cookies, followed by a layer of diagonal banana slices ([**18:33**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1113s)). Drizzle a generous amount of your homemade salted caramel right over the fruit, and then spread a thick layer of the fluffy pudding over the top ([**19:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1141s)). Repeat the layering process until the dish is filled ([**19:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1153s)). Place the completed dish into the freezer or fridge to chill completely before serving ([**20:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqZ4yUoqXOQ&t=1211s)).
recipe-section-14.html: • Grab a glass serving dish (20:15). Lay down a foundation layer of Biscoff cookies, followed by a layer of diagonal banana slices (18:33). Drizzle a generous amount of your homemade salted caramel right over the fruit, and then spread a thick layer of the fluffy pudding over the top (19:01). Repeat the layering process until the dish is filled (19:13). Place the completed dish into the freezer or fridge to chill completely before serving (20:11).
recipe-section-14.title: Step 9: Layer, Chill, and Serve
